description: This Java source file defines the main Activity class for an Android LunarLander game, managing UI components, menu options, and containing references to the game thread and view.

classes.name: LunarLander
classes.description: Main Android Activity for the LunarLander game, managing lifecycle, menu options, and interactions with LunarView and LunarThread.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with game control options like start, stop, pause, resume, and difficulty levels.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering game state changes like starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and setting difficulty.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, obtains references to LunarView and LunarThread, and manages game state restoration.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the game thread when the activity loses focus.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state into a bundle for activity state restoration.
